decision: OUTER_DIAMOND_IMPROVEMENT only if the complete fresh test stays within budget, controls and calibration certificates pass, and at rho=32768,T=1.5 availability and guarded adoption are >=0.8 of all 16 clouds and the three guarded RMS ratios against volume_shell are <=0.75. scope: Paired nested flat 2+1 Minkowski diamonds at known fixed density. Original inner supports, weights, scale, marks, colours, candidate cap and every inference/guard constant remain fixed. No adaptive supports or multi-frame reconstruction.
